main.description: An annotation ontology: a collection of typed definitions (entity types, situation types, role types, relation types) that together form a complete annotation framework.

description.description: Detailed description of the ontology's purpose and scope.

domainUri.description: AT-URI of the domain definition node. Community-expandable via knowledge graph.

parentRef.description: Reference to a parent ontology this one extends.

personaRef.description: Reference to the persona that created/owns this ontology.

knowledgeRefs.description: Knowledge graph references grounding this ontology.

licensing.description: Licensing terms governing this ontology (supports dual/multi/component licensing).

eprintRefs.description: Eprint records (papers/preprints) describing or associated with this ontology.

metadata.description: Provenance: who authored this ontology, with what tool, under what persona.

features.description: Open-ended features describing this ontology (e.g., release channel, coverage, status).

reproducibility.description: How this ontology was produced (code, commit, command, environment, seed, funding, ethics approvals).

createdAt.description: When this ontology record was created.

languages.description: BCP-47 language tags this ontology covers. Empty when language is unspecified or language-independent.

languageRefs.description: Structured language references (canonical BCP-47 tag plus optional script, region, variety, and role) grounding the languages this ontology covers.
